scope: Original canonical RTC IO-worker lifetime and readiness metadata. Ordinary production upper WebRTC library compiled; isolated metadata concurrency controls plus actual local Core/RTC resource and PCMU+VP8 probes. No new signed-host/browser/Opus+VP8/full fallback qualification in this commit.
implementation: Readiness no longer treats failure to acquire the IO worker setup mutex as worker withdrawal. Only successful original activation plus a live monotonic shared worker token confirms IO; setup retains the original join handles.

Activation still requires nonempty installed original worker handles, an open setup and a live token after the actual Core port readiness observation. Any exit/drop retires shared readiness. Normal completion publishes retirement before accessing setup metadata; close also retires before moving handles into its original join owner.

The lifetime guard is constructed before spawning and captured by the future, covering abort-before-first-poll. A late ready store cannot resurrect a cancelled original worker token. Source jobs, physical binding, SSRC/PT/codec/clock/permission/selection/age checks and original joined cleanup are retained. These lifetime bits cannot grant media authorization.
